032public class SupportFleetSpawner implements RouteFleetSpawner {
033
034        public static String ROUTE_SOURCE = "support_fleet";
035        
036        public static int PREP_PHASE = 0;
037        public static int TRAVEL_PHASE = 1;
038        public static int WAIT_PHASE = 2;
039        public static int RETURN_PHASE = 3;
040        
041        public static float WAIT_DAYS = 120f;
042        
043        
044        public static RouteData addSupportFleetRoute(SupportFleetType type, SupportFleetSize size, 
045                                                SectorEntityToken dest, MarketAPI from, boolean fastMode) {
046                
047                //StarSystemAPI system = dest.getStarSystem();
048                StarSystemAPI system = Misc.getStarSystemForAnchor(dest);
049                if (system == null) return null;
050                
051                final JumpPointAPI inner = Misc.getDistressJumpPoint(system);
052                if (inner == null) return null;
053
054                OptionalFleetData extra = new OptionalFleetData(from);
055                extra.fleetType = FleetTypes.SUPPLY_FLEET;
056                if (type == SupportFleetType.TASK_FORCE) {
057                        extra.fleetType = FleetTypes.TASK_FORCE;
058                }
059
060                float days = RouteLocationCalculator.getTravelDays(from.getPrimaryEntity(), dest);
061                
062                SupportFleetSpawner spawner = new SupportFleetSpawner(type, size, dest, from, days);
063                RouteData route = RouteManager.getInstance().addRoute(ROUTE_SOURCE, from, 
064                                Misc.genRandomSeed(), extra, spawner, null);
065                extra.strength = getBaseCombatFP(type, size);
066                extra.strength = Misc.getAdjustedStrength(extra.strength, from);
067                
068                
069                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(PREP_PHASE, 1f, from.getPrimaryEntity()));
070                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(TRAVEL_PHASE, days, from.getPrimaryEntity(), inner));
071                
072                float waitDays = WAIT_DAYS;
073                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(WAIT_PHASE, waitDays, inner));
074                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(RETURN_PHASE, days, inner, from.getPrimaryEntity()));
075                
076                if (fastMode) {
077                        route.getSegments().get(0).setElapsed(route.getSegments().get(0).daysMax);
078                        route.getSegments().get(1).setElapsed(days - 4f);
079                } else {
080                        if (!Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) {
081                                route.setDelay(1f);
082                        }
083                }
084                
085                return route;
086        }
087        
088        public static float getBaseCombatFP(SupportFleetType type, SupportFleetSize size) {
089                float fp = 0f;
090                switch (size) {
091                case LARGE:
092                        fp = 400;
093                        break;
094                case MEDIUM:
095                        fp = 300;
096                        break;
097                case SMALL:
098                        fp = 200;
099                        break;
100                }
101                
102                if (type == SupportFleetType.RESUPPLY) {
103                        fp *= 0.25f;
104                }
105                return fp;
106        }
107        
108
109        protected SupportFleetType type;
110        protected SupportFleetSize size;
111        protected SectorEntityToken dest;
112        protected MarketAPI from;
113        protected float travelDays;
114        
115        public SupportFleetSpawner(SupportFleetType type, SupportFleetSize size, SectorEntityToken dest, MarketAPI from, float days) {
116                this.type = type;
117                this.size = size;
118                this.dest = dest;
119                this.from = from;
120                this.travelDays = days;
121        }
122        
123        @Override
124        public CampaignFleetAPI spawnFleet(RouteData route) {
125                Random random = route.getRandom();
126                
127                
128                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = null;
129                if (type == SupportFleetType.TASK_FORCE) {
130                        Vector2f loc = from.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation();
131                        
132                        FleetCreatorMission m = new FleetCreatorMission(random);
133                        m.beginFleet();
134                        float fSize = 0f;
135                        int tugs = 0;
136                        switch (this.size) {
137                        case LARGE: 
138                                fSize = 1.0f;
139                                tugs = 2;
140                                break;
141                        case MEDIUM:
142                                fSize = 0.75f;
143                                tugs = 1;
144                                break;
145                        case SMALL:
146                                fSize = 0.5f;
147                                tugs = 1;
148                                break;
149                        }
150                        
151                        float sizeMult = from.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.COMBAT_FLEET_SIZE_MULT).computeEffective(0f);
152                        if (sizeMult > 1f) {
153                                fSize += sizeMult * 0.05f;
154                        }
155                        
156                        FactionDoctrineAPI doctrine = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().getDoctrine();
157                        // already accounted for in sizeMult
158                        //fSize += (float) (doctrine.getNumShips() - 1f) * 0.025f;
159                        float officerMult = 1f;
160                        officerMult += (float) (doctrine.getOfficerQuality() - 1f) * 1f;
161                        
162                        m.triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.MEDIUM, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, Factions.PLAYER, FleetTypes.TASK_FORCE, loc);
163                        //m.getPreviousCreateFleetAction().params.ignoreMarketFleetSizeMult = false;
164                        m.getPreviousCreateFleetAction().fSizeOverride = fSize;
165                        m.getPreviousCreateFleetAction().params.ignoreMarketFleetSizeMult = true;
166                        
167                        m.getPreviousCreateFleetAction().params.officerNumberMult = officerMult; // max officers, within limit
168                        if (doctrine.getOfficerQuality() >= 4) {
169                                m.getPreviousCreateFleetAction().params.officerLevelLimit = 6;
170                        }
171                        
172                        m.triggerSetFleetOfficers(OfficerNum.DEFAULT, OfficerQuality.DEFAULT);
173                        m.triggerSetWarFleet();
174                        m.triggerFleetMakeFaster(true, tugs, false);
175                        m.triggerSetFleetMemoryValue(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SOURCE_MARKET, from.getId());
176                        
177                        fleet = m.createFleet();
178                } else {
179                        float combat = getBaseCombatFP(type, size);
180                        float strMult = 0.75f + 0.25f * Math.max(0f, 1f - travelDays/40f);
181                        float nonCombatMult = 0.25f + 0.75f * Math.min(1f, travelDays/40f);
182                        
183                        
184                        float tanker = 0f;
185                        float freighter = 0f;
186                        float transport = 0f;
187                        
188                        String fleetType = FleetTypes.SUPPLY_FLEET;
189                        nonCombatMult = 0.75f + 0.25f * Math.min(1f, travelDays/40f);
190                        tanker = 30f;
191                        freighter = 20f;
192                        transport = 10f;
193                        switch (size) {
194                        case LARGE:
195                                nonCombatMult *= 3f;
196                                break;
197                        case MEDIUM:
198                                nonCombatMult *= 2f;
199                                break;
200                        case SMALL:
201                                break;
202                        }
203                        
204                        combat *= strMult;
205                        tanker *= nonCombatMult;
206                        freighter *= nonCombatMult;
207                        
208                        FleetParamsV3 params = new FleetParamsV3(
209                                        route.getMarket(), 
210                                        null,
211                                        Factions.PLAYER,
212                                        route.getQualityOverride(),
213                                        fleetType,
214                                        combat, // combatPts
215                                        freighter, // freighterPts 
216                                        tanker, // tankerPts
217                                        transport/2f, // transportPts
218                                        transport/2f, // linerPts
219                                        0f, // utilityPts
220                                        0f // qualityMod
221                                        );
222                        // otherwise, either small-fleet-size-mult fleets are too expensive
223                        // or you get net-cheaper supplies etc on the high end
224                        params.ignoreMarketFleetSizeMult = true;
225                        params.timestamp = route.getTimestamp();
226                        params.random = random;
227                        fleet = FleetFactoryV3.createFleet(params);
228                }
229                
230                if (fleet == null || fleet.isEmpty()) return null;
231                
232                fleet.setFacing((float) Math.random() * 360f);
233                
234                // this will all get overridden by the assignment AI, depending on route-time elapsed etc
235                route.getMarket().getContainingLocation().addEntity(fleet);
236                fleet.setLocation(route.getMarket().getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().x, route.getMarket().getPrimaryEntity().getLocation().x);
237                
238                if (type == SupportFleetType.RESUPPLY) {
239                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_FLEET_BUYS_STUFF, true);
240                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_FLEET_BUYS_STUFF_RATE, SellToFleet.RESUPPLY_FLEET_SELL_VALUE_MULT);
241                }
242                
243                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_FLEET_DO_NOT_GET_SIDETRACKED, true);
244                //fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_ALLOW_LONG_PURSUIT, true); // for following playeer
245                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$supportFleet", true);
246                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$supportFleetType", type.name());
247                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$supportFleetSize", size.name());
248                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$supportFleetSpawnFP", fleet.getFleetPoints());
249                
250                SupportFleetAssignmentAI ai = new SupportFleetAssignmentAI(this, fleet, route);
251                fleet.addScript(ai);
252                
253                fleet.setNoAutoDespawn(true);
254                
255                return fleet;
256        }
257        
258

260        public boolean shouldCancelRouteAfterDelayCheck(RouteData route) {
261                return false;
262        }
263
264        @Override
265        public boolean shouldRepeat(RouteData route) {
266                return false;
267        }
268

270        public void reportAboutToBeDespawnedByRouteManager(RouteData route) {
271        }
